    Both Cats Ate Them. The Gray One Licked the Plate Clean.

    I was sent a tin of Native Pet Hairball chews to try with my cats, and I'll be honest — I braced for the usual sniff-and-walk-away routine. That is not what happened.

    The tabby went straight for them, and the gray one (pictured) licked the paper plate clean afterward. Tasty chicken flavor, apparently irresistible.

    They're small soft chews — one per pound of body weight, given with meals — with miscanthus fiber and postbiotics for digestion and hairball control. Vet developed, clean ingredients, and the tin seals up nicely.

    Too early for a full verdict on the hairball front, but the taste test passed with flying colors. I'll update once we've worked through the tin.
